faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Quick answers to the questions people ask before they book.
faq.q1: Is the AI ROI Sprint just a workshop?
faq.a1: No. You leave with real outputs: an opportunity matrix, a simple ROI model, and a 90-day plan—plus a build-ready spec for Pilot #1.
faq.q2: Do you build anything during the Sprint?
faq.a2: Usually no. The Sprint is for clarity + prioritization + ROI validation. If you want implementation, that's the AI ROI Pilot (4–6 weeks).
faq.a3: We start with time savings (the most defensible). If relevant, we also model revenue uplift (conversion, cycle time) conservatively and validate assumptions with your team.
faq.q4: What do you need from us?
faq.a4: A point of contact, access to 3–5 people for interviews (leadership + users), and agreement on 1–2 outcomes you care about (time, cost, revenue).
faq.confirmFit: and we'll confirm fit in 15 minutes.

faq.title: FAQ (Before you book)
faq.subtitle: These are the questions that decide whether a Sprint is worth it. Here are direct answers.
faq.q1: Is the AI ROI Sprint just a workshop?
faq.a1: No. It's a fixed-scope engagement with deliverables: workflow reality map, ranked opportunity matrix, ROI model, and a 90-day execution plan.
faq.q2: What's the biggest outcome of the Sprint?
faq.a2: You stop guessing. You leave knowing what to build first, why it matters, and how you'll measure success in the next 90 days.
faq.q3: Do you build anything during the Sprint?
faq.a3: Not typically. The Sprint is designed to choose the right first win and define it properly. Building happens in the AI ROI Pilot (4–6 weeks).
faq.q4: What if we already tried AI and it didn't work?
faq.a4: That's common. Usually the missing piece is prioritization, workflow integration, adoption, or guardrails. The Sprint finds what blocked ROI and fixes the approach.
faq.q5: Do we need perfect data before we start?
faq.a5: No. We start workflow-first and identify the minimum viable data needed. If data quality is the blocker, the Sprint makes that visible early so you don't waste time building the wrong thing.
faq.a6: That's not the goal. For high-trust work, we design human-in-the-loop by default. AI supports the team; it doesn't undermine the relationship.
faq.a7: Tool-agnostic. We work with your current stack and recommend the simplest approach that gets a measurable result. No forced platform decisions.
faq.a8: We model ROI in two layers: (1) Time saved → cost savings (most defensible), and (2) Revenue uplift (optional, conservative, validated—e.g., improved follow-up, conversion, cycle time).
faq.q9: How fast can we see results?
faq.a9: Clarity in 2 weeks (Sprint). A first production pilot can usually ship in 4–6 weeks after that. Measurement starts from day one.
faq.q10: What do you need from us to make this work?
faq.a10: One point of contact, 3–5 interviews (leadership + users), and agreement on 1–2 business outcomes to optimize. If you can't allocate this, the Sprint won't be worth it—and we'll tell you upfront.
faq.bottomText: If you want a 90-day plan you can actually execute, start with the Sprint.
